A has structured team cards and styled CTA; B's content runs flush to the viewport edge with no padding.

A has strong hero CTA and well-spaced location cards; B uses cramped chips and an odd red CTA band.
A's typewriter font and soft palette suit retro nostalgia; B is polished but generic with awkward card gaps.

A has stronger stats and plan hierarchy; B fits earthy tone better but pricing is tiny and buttons unstyled.

A has clear feature cards and testimonial; B is mostly empty with flush-left text under a large bare hero.
A has bold warm hero, CTA and pricing cards; B's pricing is unstyled, flush left with default buttons.
